_selection.criterion: Samples are selected for whether the RE agent reads the ORIGINAL sample: Ghidra analysed the submitted binary itself, and production's agent input was that binary (source original_sample), not a dropped runtime, an installer wrapper or a CAPE payload. None of them exercises cross-tool correlation: zero cross-process injection writes, and Volatility did not trigger. So this corpus measures RE on a real binary with only CAPE signatures as correlated evidence. That is a different measurement from corpus-native.json, which is selected for exercising correlation, and the two are never pooled.
_selection.split: Its own manifest rather than additions to corpus-native.json (owner's decision, 2026-10-08), so that every earlier corpus-native scorecard stays comparable. The provenance stamp records which manifest produced a scorecard (#486).
_selection.source: Intake batch 2026-10-07 (#716): 10 MalwareBazaar samples first seen 2026-09-25..10-07, detonated 2026-10-08. All 10 passed promotion's dry run (#634 leak check clean). These 4 met the criterion.
